text:
This notice should be read with the ILO Work in Fishing Convention, 2007 (No. 188) Article 22, on private employment agencies and UK employment legislation listed in annex A and replaces MGN 620 (F) ILO work in fishing recruitment and placement of fishermen.

Amendment 1 updates references only.

Notice to:

fishing vessel owners

operators and managers

employers of fishermen

skippers

masters

officers

fishermen on fishing vessels
